tasks.title: Validate aliased assertion inputs before accepting durable state
tasks.intent: Repair the demonstrated profile-audit constructor bypass and check the same boundary across canonical assertion inputs before native-v1 assessment.
requirements: A programmatic caller must not bypass constructor validity by mutating borrowed assertion evidence or observation collections before a transition. Cover profile audits, planning assertions and task evidence/reviews through shared lifecycle validation.

Reject invalid assertions before accepting a prospective state, returning a writable file plan or committing ledger mutations. Preserve exact historical assertion protocols, contract hashes and evidence; do not reinterpret legacy time or claim evidence truth.

Use the typed domain and existing validation semantics, without Any, unchecked casts, broad Native Image allowances, implicit Git operations, provider bypasses or consumer mutations. Document any remaining ownership or concurrency limits.
acceptance: Retain a completed red witness and regressions proving invalid aliased inputs are rejected, valid assertions survive cold reconstruction and unrelated file bytes/mtimes remain unchanged.
Shared JVM/native behavioral and packaged process parity plus affected remote/client integration pass. Existing historical hash/evidence witnesses retain their meaning before the v1 assessment.

review.rationale: The still-open v1 assessment retains every prior gate and gains the demonstrated assertion-boundary correction. This reviews the future plan only and does not claim implementation or freeze readiness.

evidence.checkpoint: Reviewed docs/proof/assertion-boundaries/baseline.json and the preserved reducer probe against the new bounded correction contract; all prior prerequisites and historical evidence remain.

assessment.title: Assess native v1 freeze readiness
assessment.intent: Consider v1 only after greenfield, existing-code, legacy-import and remote-backed usage have survived.
requirements: Consider v1 only after greenfield, existing-code, legacy-import and remote-backed usage have survived.
The checkpoint correction gates, including bounded read models and the transitively required planning, provider and timestamp proofs, must be closed/current before assessing native v1.
The reproduced mutable-value/input-boundary defect must be corrected with closed/current TASK.protocol.value-boundary evidence before assessing native v1.
The reproduced profile-audit/assertion-input defect must be corrected with closed/current TASK.protocol.assertion-boundary evidence before assessing native v1.
acceptance: Evidence from all four entry paths and complex migrations supports a reviewed protocol freeze decision.
